COMMENT.Keys: Keys are made up of parent setting/class/function, wrapper function, prefix and description
COMMENT.prefixes: numbers for when text is a fragment of a setDesc, 'alt+number' for when it is conditional

-------- SETTINGS TAB: This is the class in which the user chooses their settings for the plugin.-------------
------ SET SYSTEM FOLDER: Here the user chooses which path the system folder should have ----------------
setSystemFolder.setName choose existing: Choose an existing folder in which to put textFlow's system folder - ${textFlowSystemFolderName}.
setSystemFolder.setDesc.1 what is system: TextFlow needs a (hidden) system folder to store its flows in.
setSystemFolder.setDesc.2 how to enter r: Enter / or . to choose the root folder.
------ SWITCHER MODAL POSITION: How do they want to access the flow switcher modal?  ----------------
switcherModalPosition.setName access flo: Access to the flow switcher modal via...
switcherModalPosition.setDesc changes ne: Changes need a vault reload to take effect.
------ EXPLORER DECORATION: Choose unicode characters to decorate source notes in file explorer ----------------
explorerDeco.setDesc.2 what does deco do: Marks the source notes of all currently active (opened) flows.
explorerDeco.setDesc.3 what do symbols m: First symbol: up to date; second symbol: waiting for sync.
explorerDeco.setDesc.4 how to set colour: The colour is the accent you chose in Obsidian's 'Appearance' settings.
-------- ACTIVE REGION HIGHLIGHT: Choose a decoration style for the active region's source note
activeRegionDeco.setDesc what does this: How do you want the active region's source note to be highlighted?
-------- QUALITY OF LIVE SETTINGS: Some settings to clean up/debug the UI
qol.navListener.setDesc what is disable: Toggle this on if you need multi-select to work correctly. There's command, too.
qol.scrollbar.setName.1 what is hide sco: When long notes/sections are on the screen, the scroll bar starts twitching. If that annoys you, you can hide it.
qol.scrollbar.setName.2 there's a toggle: There's also a command to toggle between 'hide everywhere' and 'don't hide'.
qol.hash.setDesc.1 when should you check: If you often edit this vault on machines that can't run textFlow (like your phone), you should activate this.
qol.hash.setDesc.2 mtime: textFlow will compare your source notes' modification time.
qol.hash.setDesc.3 xxhash: If mtime produces too many false positives (unnecessary rebuilds) for you, select 'xxhash', so textFlow will also compare the hashed contents of a note.
qol.hidesystemFolder.setDesc.1 hiding is: Hiding this folder is recommended to protect its contents, but ultimately, it's an aesthetic and practical choice.
qol.hidesystemFolder.setDesc.2 edits are: If you open flows directly from the folder, they will still be protected and tracked.
qol.hidesystemFolder.setDesc.3 unhiding: Unhiding the folder needs a vault reload to take effect.

toggleFolderTitles.setDesc will also tur: This will also turn off folder titles in the flow navigation dropdown.
defineFlow.setDesc.1 only active method: Only the active definition method will be used for your definition.
bookmarksSortOrder.setDesc.2 description: Note order overrides folder order. Best for flat hierarchy (and group titles off).
bookmarksSortOrder.setDesc.4 description: Folder order overrides note order. Best for deep hierarchy (and group titles on).
bookmarksSortOrder.setDesc.6 description: Exact order of groups and notes is preserved. Best with group titles off.
bookmarksSortOrder.setDesc.7 test them a: Test out all options in the preview to see which order fits you best.
chooseBookmarks.setDesc.1 input the name: Input the name of a bookmarks group.
chooseBookmarks.setDesc.2 how to choose: To choose a subgroup, enter its path like this:
chooseBookmarks.setDesc.4 how to exclude: To exclude a group's subgroups end its name or path with /
sortFlowPathsTagsProperties.setDesc.2 de: Note order overrides folder order. Best for flat hierarchy (and folder titles off).
sortFlowPathsTagsProperties.setDesc.4 de: Folder order overrides note order. Best for deep hierarchy (and folder titles on).
sortFlowPathsTagsProperties.setDesc.5 te: Test out all options in the preview to see which order fits you best.

If you need more complex logic, consider defining your flow using a dataview query and tagging the results with your flow's name.

folderIncludeInput.setDesc.3 how to exlu: End path with / to not include subfolders.

textFlow: The note at ${path} has been externally edited at ${timestamp}, which is after you last (re)built flow ${flowName}. 
Please check if you really want to overwrite it. 
Procedure to overwrite: 
1. Copy the edit you just made.
2. Rebuild the flow. 
3. Paste the edit back into its spot. 
 4. Sync the flow.

textFlow: Region tracking error.

Please redo (ctrl+shift+z) your way back into the current version of things.
If that doesn't seem to work, please rebuild ${flow.flowName}.
This may lead to further error messages. Please follow their instructions.

flowBUilder.notice UUID found in source:
textFlow: The note
 ${ingredient}
 of flow
 ${flowName}
 contains at least one UUID.
 This can come about due to sync errors.
How to proceed safely: 
1. Export ${flowName} to prevent any loss of edits and backup your vault, just to be safe.
2. Check the mentioned note for any additional regions that were accidentally copied into it (search for '<hr>'), and cut them out.
3. Check the source notes of these regions to make sure they are up to date; if they aren't, copy/paste the latest version from your exported flow.
To make all of this easier, turn off navigation via file explorer (in the settings tab or command palette).
Afterwards try another rebuild.
